title: Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technicians
description: Perform routine medical laboratory tests for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease. May work under the supervision of a medical technologist.

tasks.text: Perform quality control analyses to ensure accuracy of test results.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes test results against criteria

dwas.name: Analyze test results.
Evaluate data quality.
Interpret design or operational test results.
Direct quality control activities.

tasks.text: Conduct blood tests for transfusion purposes and perform blood counts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Specimen testing needs lab equipment operation

dwas.name: Test biological specimens to gather information about patient conditions.

tasks.text: Conduct chemical analyses of body fluids, such as blood or urine, using microscope or automatic analyzer to detect abnormalities or diseases and enter findings into computer.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Patient data entry largely automatable with review

dwas.name: Analyze laboratory specimens to detect abnormalities or other problems.
Operate laboratory equipment to analyze medical samples.
Enter patient or treatment data into computers.

tasks.text: Analyze the results of tests or experiments to ensure conformity to specifications, using special mechanical or electrical devices.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Lab finding interpretation; technician verifies results

dwas.name: Analyze laboratory findings.

tasks.text: Set up, maintain, calibrate, clean, and test sterility of medical laboratory equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assembly of medical supplies

dwas.name: Clean medical equipment or facilities.
Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.
Maintain medical laboratory equipment.

tasks.text: Examine cells stained with dye to locate abnormalities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Specimen analysis requires lab instruments and hands

dwas.name: Analyze laboratory specimens to detect abnormalities or other problems.

tasks.text: Prepare standard volumetric solutions or reagents to be combined with samples, following standardized formulas or experimental procedures.

dwas.name: Prepare biological specimens for laboratory analysis.

tasks.text: Supervise or instruct other technicians or laboratory assistants.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise technical medical personnel.

tasks.text: Consult with a pathologist to determine a final diagnosis when abnormal cells are found.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Obtain specimens, cultivating, isolating, and identifying microorganisms for analysis.

dwas.name: Collect biological specimens from patients.
Cultivate micro-organisms for study, testing, or medical preparations.
Prepare biological specimens for laboratory analysis.

tasks.text: Collect blood or tissue samples from patients, observing principles of asepsis to obtain blood sample.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Invasive specimen collection needs hands-on clinical skill

dwas.name: Collect biological specimens from patients.

tasks.text: Test raw materials, processes, or finished products to determine quality or quantity of materials or characteristics of a substance.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Quality testing of materials is hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Test materials, solutions, or samples.
Test quality of materials or finished products.

tasks.text: Analyze and record test data to issue reports that use charts, graphs, or narratives.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Inoculate fertilized eggs, broths, or other bacteriological media with organisms.

dwas.name: Cultivate micro-organisms for study, testing, or medical preparations.
Prepare biological specimens for laboratory analysis.
